title: 第1059章 异域四位老祖第1058章 战后圣渊
slug: 穿越大乾从病秧子开始蜕变
lines: 他们那些咆哮声已不再被封印完全给隔绝，而是化作一阵阵沉闷且刺耳的低吼，在圣渊底部不断回荡！
震得石壁上的碎石簌簌落下。
更让他心头发紧的，是那股已经弥漫到圣渊每一个角落的气息。
气息腐朽而灼热，好似无数尸体堆积在烈日下腐烂后、所散发出的味道，带着一种令人作呕的甜腻。
它已穿透封印的裂缝，正在以肉眼可见的速度侵蚀着圣渊中的元气，让原本稀薄的天地本源变得浑浊、粘稠、充满侵略性。
“这一战……天地本源的震荡太剧烈。”
沐清漪的声音从身后传来，带着一种极力压制却依旧透出焦灼的疲惫。
“那些异族借此机会疯狂冲击封印，再加上它们以鲜血腐蚀……封印的衰败速度比我们预想的快出数倍。”
方云逸目光盯着那道最宽的裂缝，看到裂缝边缘的符文正在一枚接一枚地炸裂，每一次炸裂都伴随着一阵暗金色的火花，宛如最后一滴油被燃尽的灯盏。
九根镇渊神柱上那曾经巍然如山的暗金色神纹，此刻已黯淡到无法辨认，柱身表面布满细密的龟裂纹，犹如干旱万年的河床。
这样下去，彼岸封印坚持不了多久！
与此同时，在封印光幕的另一侧，那片被灰黑色混沌雾气笼罩的虚空中，正上演着一场更加恐怖的景象。
数百道巨大的阴影悬浮在雾气之中，如同是一座座移动的山岳横亘在天穹之上。
在这些悬浮阴影的前方，有四道身影好似四颗悬挂在虚空中的星辰，格外醒目！
左侧的是一尊身高百丈的人形存在，通体覆盖着暗金色的鳞甲，每一片鳞甲上都流转着细密的道则纹路。
此人面容苍老而刚毅，双眸如同两轮燃烧着暗金色火焰的烈日，目光所过之处，虚空都为之扭曲。
他身后悬浮着一柄通体漆黑的巨剑，剑身上流淌着细密如血管般的赤红色纹路，每一次跳动都伴随着一阵低沉的嗡鸣。
此人是异族这边的真神境老祖，道号“墨渊狱主”
，以杀伐之道入真神境，在上古大战中曾与数位道境大能血战七日而不败。
右侧的是一尊形态极为诡异的存在。
它的身躯如一团不断翻涌的暗紫色水银……
没有固定的形态，却在水银表面不断浮现出无数张痛苦扭曲的面孔，每一张面孔都在无声地嘶嚎。
那些面孔中有人形、有兽形、还有一些根本无法辨认的形态，它们皆是在水银表面游走、沉浮、消散、再浮现，仿佛无数被吞噬的生灵怨念在永无止境地轮回。
此人是新出现的第二位真神境老祖，道号“噬魂帝君”
，专精灵魂之道，以吞噬亿万生灵的神魂铸就大道根基。
居中靠前的位置，则是摩罗耶老祖，此刻已化为人形，一身灰黑色长袍，面容苍老如万年岩石！
以及一道没有固定形态、周身却是悬浮着无数只眼睛的无定形存在，每一只眼睛中都闪烁着诡异的光芒。
四位真神境老祖悬浮在虚空之中，四人的气息交织在一起，好似一座无形的万丈山岳压在整片虚空中，让那些成百上千的异界大能都不由自主地微微躬身。
“可惜！”
墨渊狱主的声音如金属摩擦般低沉而沙哑，目光透过翻涌的混沌雾气，落在那道正在减缓崩裂的封印光幕上。
“那边的战斗停了。
若是再继续半天，今日未必不能一举破开这道该死的屏障。”
content_en:
Their roars are no longer completely isolated by the seal, but have turned into waves of dull and harsh roars, constantly echoing at the bottom of the Holy Abyss!
The shock caused the gravel on the stone wall to fall.
What made his heart even more tense was the aura that had permeated every corner of the Holy Abyss.
The smell was rotten and hot, like the smell of countless corpses piled up and rotting under the scorching sun, with a sickening sweetness.
It has penetrated the cracks in the seal and is eroding the vitality in the Holy Abyss at a speed visible to the naked eye, making the original thin source of heaven and earth turbid, sticky, and full of aggression.
“这一战……天地本源的震荡太剧烈。”
Mu Qingyi's voice came from behind, with a kind of anxious exhaustion that was suppressed but still revealed.
"Those alien races took this opportunity to attack the seal crazily, and coupled with the fact that they corroded it with blood... the seal's decay rate was several times faster than we expected."
Fang Yunyi stared at the widest crack and saw that the runes on the edge of the crack were exploding one after another. Each explosion was accompanied by a burst of dark golden sparks, like a lamp with the last drop of oil burned out.
The dark golden divine patterns on the nine Zhenyuan Divine Pillars, which were once as majestic as mountains, are now so dim that they cannot be recognized. The surface of the pillars is covered with fine cracks, like a river bed that has been dry for thousands of years.
If this continues, the seal on the other side won't last long!
与此同时，在封印光幕的另一侧，那片被灰黑色混沌雾气笼罩的虚空中，正上演着一场更加恐怖的景象。
Hundreds of huge shadows were suspended in the mist, like moving mountains stretching across the sky.
In front of these suspended shadows, there are four figures that look like four stars hanging in the void, which are particularly eye-catching!
The one on the left is a humanoid being a hundred feet tall. His whole body is covered with dark golden scales, and each scale is covered with fine Dao lines.
This man's face was old and resolute, and his eyes were like two scorching suns burning with dark golden flames. Wherever his eyes passed, the void was distorted.
There was a giant black sword suspended behind him, with red veins as fine as blood vessels flowing on the sword, and every beat was accompanied by a low hum.
This person is the ancestor of the True God Realm from the foreign race, and his Taoist name is "Prison Master Moyuan"
, entered the True God Realm through the way of killing, and in the ancient war, he fought bloody battles with several Tao Realm masters for seven days without defeat.
The one on the right is an existence with an extremely strange shape.
Its body is like a ball of dark purple mercury that is constantly surging...
没有固定的形态，却在水银表面不断浮现出无数张痛苦扭曲的面孔，每一张面孔都在无声地嘶嚎。
Among those faces were human figures, animal figures, and some completely unrecognizable forms. They all wandered, floated, dissipated, and reappeared on the surface of mercury, as if the resentments of countless devoured creatures were reincarnating in an endless cycle.
此人是新出现的第二位真神境老祖，道号“噬魂帝君”
, specializes in the way of the soul, and uses the souls of hundreds of millions of creatures to forge the foundation of the avenue.
In the middle and front position is Patriarch Moroye, who has turned into a human form at this moment, wearing a gray-black robe, and his face is as old as a ten-thousand-year-old rock!
And an amorphous existence with no fixed form but countless eyes floating around it, each eye shining with a strange light.
The four True God Realm ancestors were suspended in the void, and their auras were intertwined, like an invisible mountain weighing down the entire void, causing hundreds of mighty powers from other worlds to bow slightly involuntarily.
"What a pity!"
Prison Master Mo Yuan's voice was as low and hoarse as metal friction, and his gaze fell on the sealing light curtain that was slowing down the cracking through the surging chaotic mist.
“The fighting over there has stopped.
If he continued for another half day, he might not be able to break through this damn barrier in one fell swoop today. "
